heroNarrative.title: Follow the budget. Find the story.
heroNarrative.lede: We follow Kenya's public money from budget promise to county delivery—turning complex government spending into evidence citizens, journalists and partners can act on.

thesis.title: Three bets. Year-round accountability.
thesis.body: Budget Ndio Story verifies what Treasury and counties publish, embeds where delivery happens, and trains newsrooms to stay forensic after Budget Day - so partners fund accountability they can brief and cite.

programmeExplains.name: BNS Connect
programmeExplains.title: National budget intelligence
programmeExplains.lede: Tracking the KSh 4.8T national budget from Treasury allocation to ministry execution.

programmeExplains.name: BNS Mashinani
programmeExplains.title: County delivery verification
programmeExplains.lede: Embedded teams verifying capital delivery across 4 counties (Kakamega, Kitui, Nakuru, Wajir).

programmeExplains.name: Wanahabari Lab
programmeExplains.title: Newsroom scrutiny
programmeExplains.lede: Year-round investigative reporting, moving beyond the 48-hour Budget Day news cycle.

featuredIntro.headline: Our Evidence Base
featuredIntro.lede: Published investigations, documentaries, and field evidence from across our three programmes.

partnerCta.title: Your mandate. Our evidence.
partnerCta.description: Whether you're funding accountability, strengthening public participation, or supporting journalism, BNS brings grounded evidence into the work.

hero.body: Kenya's public money moves fast, and mostly out of sight. We turn opaque fiscal policy into verified intelligence for partners, institutions, and newsrooms - nationally and in select counties.

storyIntro.title: Featured programme evidence
storyIntro.body: House of Fiscal Wisdom with Dr. Lyla Latif - forensic briefing on illicit financial flows, produced with Wanahabari Lab as evidence partners can brief against.

images.alt: Budget Ndio Story programme delivery session

storyIntro.youtubeTitle: Dr. Lyla Latif - illicit financial flows briefing (House of Fiscal Wisdom)

programmesStrip.title: Our programmes
programmesStrip.description: Connect, Mashinani, and Wanahabari - with production and commissions captured through BNS Studio.

tiktok.description: Snackable explainers that meet youth where they scroll - turning county fiscal data into stories anyone can share.

team.description: A dedicated group of researchers, storytellers, and tech innovators working together to bring transparency to Kenya's public budgets.

gallery.description: Moments from civic workshops, town halls, and community engagements across the country.

studioStrip.description: Browse commissioned podcasts, documentaries, animations, and civic campaigns organised by content type and organisation - every project helps fund Kenya's leading youth budget platform.
studioStrip.highlight: Every commission is double impact: evidence-based content for your audience, with proceeds reinvested into Budget Ndio Story's civic mission.
